You’ll share responsibility for one CXE queue, lead the situations where experience matters most, and convert recurring problems into tooling, AI-enabled workflows, product action, and prevention. What You Will Do Lead complex, ambiguous, enterprise, solution-led, and escalated customer issues from investigation through resolution and trust-restoring closure. Design and execute investigations across web applications, APIs, integrations, authentication, data, logs, configurations, and system behaviour, even when no playbook exists. Resolve the majority of technical issues independently and engage Engineering only with clear evidence, reproduction steps, impact, and a strong technical hypothesis. Lead high-severity incident response and customer-facing RCAs, driving containment, stakeholder alignment, proactive communication, corrective action, and follow-through. Manage multiple concurrent priorities while protecting the health of the shared queue, service levels, and communication quality across shifts and regions. Use AI and coding tools to accelerate debugging, analyse patterns, build or maintain reliable agents and automations, and contribute lightweight code or tooling fixes. Turn recurring issues into adopted runbooks, onboarding improvements, evaluation loops, automation, product feedback, or Engineering action that reduces repeat work. Mentor CXE 1 engineers through pairing, reviews, and case debriefs; raise the team’s judgment without taking ownership away from them. Partner confidently with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Account teams, making important calls and keeping accountability clear during pressure. Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs. Who You Are 3 to 7 years of experience in technical support, product support, solutions engineering, implementation, cloud support, software engineering, SDET, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Strong debugging depth across web applications, REST APIs, distributed integrations, logs, configurations, and customer workflows. Solid SQL skills and the ability to independently investigate data issues and validate platform behaviour. Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, and common identity or integration failure modes. Hands-on coding ability in Python or a similar language; comfortable reading production code and creating scripts, automations, or lightweight fixes. Proven judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, including prioritisation, incident response, and deciding when and how to involve other teams. Clear, precise, and empathetic communicator who can lead difficult calls, executive-visible updates, and multi-stakeholder customer moments. Strong ownership: you drive outcomes without being chased and remain accountable even when work crosses team boundaries. Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base. Even better if you have Debugged ATS, HR-tech, developer-tooling, or other complex B2B SaaS integrations. This is especially critical as the market is moving into the rapidly evolving combination of established process node, and advanced process nodes due to the rapidly expanding 3D and Chiplet market. You are interacting with the rest of Product Management, Technical Sales, and customers to have a complete understanding as to what specific AI use models need to be incorporated into product roadmaps to support the multiple markets that Synopsys interacts with. You are highly motivated, with a passion for innovation and the ability to work collaboratively across engineering, product management and sales teams to ensure alignment to initiatives. You are comfortable working as an individual contributor on multiple special projects while at the same time influence managing Technical Sales, R&D, and Product Management. What You’ll Be Doing: You will work with the Executive Director of Synopsys ICV for Established Nodes to conceptualize, prototype, and validate AI use models across the Synopsys ICV offering. These use models will be applicable for development and QA of core Synopsys ICV products and for customer applications throughout the Synopsys ICV product line. Special focus will be on the application of AI within strategies for Synopsys ICV established process node designs that align with advanced process nodes on the same 3D system and with overall Synopsys ICV broader business objectives. You will work with the rest of the 3D established node product managers to train and educate Synopsys Technical sales. Also work with Technical Sales to explain how to address customer unique requirements that calls for funded customization and support. You will work closely with the rest of Synopsys ICV product management, R&D and sales teams to align ICV AI based needs with Synopsys product development and go-to-market strategies. The Impact You Will Have: Accelerate Synopsys’ ICV strategic positioning in the 3D and Chiplet established node market via identification and development of competitive differentiation using AI based techniques. Strengthen Synopsys’ influence and thought leadership within the semiconductor ecosystem and customer base through compelling presentations and engagement via AI driven use models as how Synopsys ICV is the solutions for the new 3D/Chiplet market. What You’ll Need: 10+ years of relevant EDA/semiconductor product management experience. 5+ years of experience in development of solutions that include AI and LLM techniques BS/MS, in Electrical Engineering and or Device Physics required. PhD or MBA in your field desired. Understanding of Semiconductor ecosystem, and expertise with Foundry, EDA PDK development and associated relationships for DRC functions and Rules. Proven ability to work with Product Management senior managers to help define what is a customer specific need vs a general market requirement where they could be an industry leading teacher-customer. Exceptional ability to drive and achieve results by yourself and others under time pressure. Excellent presentation, communications, and interpersonal skills. Ability to travel at least 20% of the time. The Team You’ll Be A Part Of: You will be working with senior management to create a dynamic team focused on greatly expanding Synopsys’ ICV product offerings and market positioning in the established node/3D design environment. This team will work closely with Line of Business (LoB) product management, sales, and R&D to align ecosystem offerings with Synopsys’ ICV overall strategic goals. As a key component of the overall Synopsys EDA Product Management Group, this team will identify and cultivate new opportunities, drive collaborative initiatives, and promote joint marketing programs to deliver solutions to the semiconductor market that mutual established node customers need as the world moves into multiple ways to design their offerings. It is no longer just “let’s go to the next process node” but a “how do we best design this” world. review_candidates.description: We're hiring a Pricing Analyst – CX/BPO ROLE PURPOSE The Pricing Expert prices CX opportunities end-to-end: translating client RFP/RFI requirements into solid cost models and competitive commercial proposals. The role requires a real understanding of how a customer operation runs – operations, WFM, training, quality, support functions – and a hands-on use of AI tools to analyze and translate RFP/RFI documents faster and better. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Pricing & Cost Modeling: • Build bottom-up pricing models: FTEs, productivity, shrinkage, attrition, ramp, support ratios • Structure the right commercial model per deal (per hour, per transaction, per FTE, outcome-based) • Run scenarios (volumes, languages, on/near/offshore mix) and secure target margins • Ensure pricing meets group margin targets and flag deviations with clear, quantified recommendations RFP/RFI & Bid Support: • Translate client requirements (SLAs, volumes, coverage, language mix) into pricing assumptions • Use AI tools to parse, summarize, and translate multilingual RFP/RFI documentation • Own the pricing sections of proposals, working closely with solutions, operations, and sales Operational Expertise & Governance: • Challenge operational assumptions (AHT, occupancy, training duration, attrition) with credibility • Cost all layers of the operating model: front-line operations, WFM, training, quality, team leadership, and support functions • Continuously improve pricing templates and automate recurring modeling tasks • Maintain cost and productivity benchmarks to sanity-check every model • Prepare pricing approval materials and support negotiations with rapid what-if analyses PROFILE • 2+ years in pricing, solutioning, or commercial finance within the CX / BPO industry • Deep knowledge of customer operations models and their cost drivers • Advanced Excel / financial modeling skills • Hands-on user of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot...) for document analysis and translation • English profile: B2 • Autonomous, rigorous, comfortable with tight bid deadlines

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in SEO, Google Ads (CPC/PPC), Meta Ads, Social Media Management, and 360° Digital Marketing , with a proven ability to build scalable acquisition strategies, drive revenue growth, and optimize marketing performance. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role requiring strong commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and experience marketing SaaS products to B2B and B2C audiences. 360° Marketing Strategy Develop and execute comprehensive 360° marketing plans across multiple digital products. Own the marketing roadmap, budgets, channel strategy, and growth KPIs. Build integrated campaigns covering organic, paid, social, content, email, and remarketing channels. Identify market opportunities, competitive advantages, and scalable growth initiatives. Align marketing activities with business objectives, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. SEO & Organic Growth Lead technical, on-page, off-page, and programmatic SEO strategies. Develop keyword strategies, content plans, and organic acquisition funnels. Improve organic visibility, qualified traffic, and conversion rates. Manage SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and other tools. Collaborate with product, development, and content teams to implement SEO improvements. Performance Marketing Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, Performance Max, and remarketing. Manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram. Own campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and conversion tracking. Continuously optimize CPC, CPA, CAC, ROAS, and conversion rates. Build structured A/B testing and performance improvement frameworks. Scale successful campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency. Social Media & Brand Management Lead social media strategies across relevant platforms. Manage content calendars, brand messaging, and audience engagement. Oversee social media teams, content creators, and designers. Ensure consistent positioning and communication across channels. Integrate organic social media activities with paid campaigns and business goals. SaaS Growth & Customer Personas Develop detailed B2B and B2C buyer personas, including decision-makers, influencers, and end users. Understand SaaS customer journeys, acquisition funnels, and subscription models. Build acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation strategies. Develop lifecycle marketing, lead nurturing, and conversion optimization initiatives. Analyze CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and marketing funnel performance. Work closely with product and sales teams to improve lead quality, product adoption, and revenue. Marketing Leadership & Analytics Lead and coordinate SEO, performance marketing, content, and social media functions. Define measurable KPIs and establish clear reporting dashboards. Manage marketing budgets and allocate resources based on ROI. Conduct competitor analysis, market research, and growth experiments. Present marketing performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to management. Requirements 6+ years of proven experience in digital marketing, with strong exposure to SaaS, technology platforms, or digital products. Demonstrated experience developing and executing successful 360° marketing strategies. Advanced practical knowledge of SEO, including technical SEO and organic growth. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, CPC/PPC campaigns, and Meta Ads. Proven ability to manage social media strategy and execution. Solid understanding of B2B SaaS marketing, customer personas, and lead generation. Experience managing significant advertising budgets and optimizing ROI. Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and marketing analytics. Experience managing cross-functional marketing teams. Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience scaling multiple SaaS products or digital platforms. Familiarity with CRM systems, marketing automation, and lifecycle campaigns. Experience with subscription-based business models and product-led growth (PLG). Understanding of CRO, landing page optimization, and marketing attribution. Experience targeting GCC and international markets. Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and automation. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Qualified leads and customer acquisition growth. Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Organic traffic growth and SEO conversions. Paid campaign performance and conversion rates. Marketing-generated revenue and pipeline contribution. Social media engagement and audience growth. SaaS activation, retention, and customer lifetime value (LTV). Overall marketing ROI.

review_candidates.title: Corporate Account Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description Corporate Account Manager Job Title: Corporate Account Manager Location: Cairo, Egypt – Hybrid basis Contract type: Fixed term contract. We make health happen At Bupa, our purpose is helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. Every role plays a part in that mission. As a Corporate Account Manager , you'll help organisations provide access to high-quality healthcare for their employees around the world. You'll build trusted relationships with corporate clients, helping them get the most from their health insurance solutions while delivering outstanding service and support. Bupa Global supports customers wherever life takes them. Whether they're living, working, travelling or studying abroad, we help them access healthcare when and where they need it. As a Corporate Account Manager, you'll work closely with clients, internal teams and key stakeholders to strengthen partnerships, support retention, and help drive sustainable growth across our international corporate portfolio. Key Responsibilities As a Corporate Account Manager, you'll: Build and maintain strong relationships with a portfolio of corporate clients. Lead client renewal discussions and help secure successful outcomes for both clients and Bupa. Develop account plans that support client needs, retention and growth opportunities. Provide clients with insights on benefits, claims trends, product developments and market changes. Work closely with colleagues across pricing, marketing and operational teams to deliver a high-quality customer experience. Prepare and present account reviews, performance reports and client presentations. Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and enhance the client experience. Support sales and retention objectives through proactive account management. Monitor account performance and recommend solutions that create value for clients and the business. Stay informed about industry, market and regulatory developments that could affect corporate customers. Represent Bupa professionally in all client interactions and meetings. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who combines strong relationship-building skills with commercial awareness and a passion for delivering great customer experiences. You'll Ideally Have Experience in account management, client relationship management or corporate customer management. Experience within health insurance, financial services, banking, wealth management or a related industry. A proven track record of meeting or exceeding business targets and customer outcomes. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with a range of stakeholders. The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data. Experience supporting business improvement initiatives or project-based work. An understanding of risk management and commercial decision-making. A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across different teams. Why Bupa We're a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do. We encourage all of our people to "Be you at Bupa", we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That's why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We'll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them. If you require information regarding this role in an alternative format, please email: careers@bupa.com. Time Type Full time Job Area Business Development Locations: Egypt - Cairo
